conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor and Brostamide reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 2. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.9 | 4.5 | 200 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 9.4 | 4.7 | 200 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
